CalculatedInsight.description: Live event counts per match from Fan360LiveEvents__dlm. Batch Calculated Insight: schedule minimum Every 1 Hour in DE orgs. No window() or WINDOW.START — use batch SQL below. Sub-minute live needs Streaming Insight + Ingestion API (Step 6).
CalculatedInsight.label: Live Match Snapshot
CalculatedInsight.sqlExpression: SELECT Fan360LiveEvents__dlm.match_id__c AS match_id__c, Fan360LiveEvents__dlm.fixture_label__c AS fixture_label__c, COUNT(*) AS events__c, SUM(CASE WHEN Fan360LiveEvents__dlm.event_type__c = 'Shot' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shots__c, SUM(CASE WHEN Fan360LiveEvents__dlm.event_type__c = 'Goal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goals__c, SUM(CASE WHEN Fan360LiveEvents__dlm.event_type__c = 'Yellow Card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yellow_cards__c, MAX(Fan360LiveEvents__dlm.received_at__c) AS last_event_at__c FROM Fan360LiveEvents__dlm GROUP BY match_id__c, fixture_label__c
